days.title: Tectonic Gorges and Waterways
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Almannagjá
stops.detail: In the last 10,000 years, the land on both sides of the Almannagjá gorge has drifted apart by 70 meters and the valley floor has subsided by about 40 meters.

stops.name: Öxará
stops.detail: The river Öxará flows through the Þingvellir National Park and forms a noteworthy waterfall, the Öxarárfoss, at the Almannagjá gorge.

days.title: Historic Assembly and Underwater Fissures
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Thingplatz
stops.detail: Here, on the assembly site near the Almannagjá gorge, the traditional Althing assembly was held as early as 930—at the end of the settlement period primarily by Norwegian Vikings—once a year for two weeks in June, serving both legislative and judicial functions.

stops.name: Silfra-Spalte
stops.detail: In this place and the wider surroundings, the drifting apart of the American and Eurasian tectonic plates is also made visible by impressive rock fissures and cracks, especially at Almannagjá (Allman's Gorge) or the Silfra Fissure.

stops.name: Silfragjá
stops.detail: The Silfragjá (Silfra Fissure) has developed into an extraordinary diving spot.
